purpose: Defines norms for creating and revising ADRs: what to record and not record, screening criteria, mutability, handling reversed decisions, placement and numbering, and severity of violations.
summary: ADR definition: responsibility, exceptions, lifetime, and revision approach
Primary beneficiary is an AI about to propose an alternative already considered
What to write: only when a plausible proposal is likely and its error is not evident elsewhere
Do not copy specs or rules into ADRs; link to them by reference
Conditions for the optional scope box
Screening criteria table: reject, fix and record, or insufficient
Mutable document: rewrite sections, keep numbers, no history sections
Reversed decisions rewrite the same section, never add a new ADR
Placement, one file per feature, and numbering via next-spec-id
Gray-zone tolerance table and severity catalog
tasks: Deciding whether content deserves an ADR
Reviewing an ADR for norm violations
Handling a reversed or corrected decision
Numbering and placing a new ADR file
title: ADR（アーキテクチャ決定記録）運用原則
